approvalEvidence: User replied 'good' after viewing the four mockups and navigation corrections.
originalPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity mobile app screen for Hotlah, a nail-service marketplace for Kuala Lumpur/Selangor, Malaysia. This is a STATIC DESIGN REVIEW, not working software. Render one flat portrait mobile interface per image, approximately 1024 x 2048 pixels (logical 390 x 780 viewport), edge-to-edge UI, no physical phone frame, no perspective, no desk, no drop shadow around the canvas. All screens belong to exactly the same design system. Background warm ivory #FAF9EF; content off-white #FFFEFA; text and fine 1px outlines deep charcoal #24251F; primary actions solid warm yellow #FFD23F with charcoal text; confirmation deep green. Professional geometric sans-serif like Manrope, excellent legibility, clean medium-weight headings, no playful bubble type. Layout must feel like usable mobile software: 20px logical horizontal gutters, generous rhythm, clear touch targets, 12px rounded corners, subtle or no shadows, precise outlined icons. Restrained clean outlined-card styling inspired by the user's cream/yellow phone UI references, no pet characters or mascots. Nail photography is photorealistic generated illustration for the design only. English UI with short Chinese language switch where specified. Use exactly the business logic and short text supplied. No invented ratings, reviews, subscription prices, payment card forms, QR codes, exposed phone numbers, AI chat buttons, or progress bar for merchant allowance. Tiny but readable footer directly above bottom navigation: 'Design preview · Example content'. Include understated status bar with '9:41'. Make the UI crisp and credible with all text accurately rendered.
SCREEN 4 / MERCHANT TODAY DASHBOARD, same visual system but practical denser operational layout. Top brand row 'Hotlah' left; small outlined badge 'Merchant' and switch-view icon right. Greeting heading 'Good morning, Mei' and subline 'Saturday, 26 September'. A prominent but calm thin-charcoal-outlined notification panel with pale-yellow fill: small lock icon and heading 'New booking request'; explanation in two short lines 'Subscribe to view this request and respond.' Full-width yellow action with charcoal text 'View subscription'. This panel MUST NOT reveal the new customer's name, service, date, time, message, or any exact remaining allowance. Next section 'Today’s appointments' with small outlined 'Block time' action right. One existing APPROVED appointment row with left time '10:30', content 'Lina' then 'Classic gel manicure · 60 min', green text badge 'Confirmed'. Below one existing APPROVED appointment row left time '16:00', content 'Sarah' then 'French gel manicure · 75 min', same Confirmed badge. Both are previously accessible appointments, not the new locked request. Section 'Your reach' with small 'This month'. Two equal simple outlined statistic blocks: 'Profile views' value '248'; 'Click-through rate' value '6.2%'. A subtle text action 'View insights'. No earnings chart, no fabricated testimonials, no subscription price, no quota counter, no countdown. Bottom fixed merchant navigation exactly 'Today' active yellow, 'Calendar', 'Messages', 'Business'. The only application-changing primary CTA is View subscription; Block time remains a secondary outlined control.
content: All merchant names, customer names, prices, photographs, availability, and metrics are illustrative examples, not verified commercial content.
